notes.title: Chaos in the Galaxy Update
notes.content:
Hey rebel, long time no transmission!

You’ve been out there, deep in galaxies, digging through ash, dodging lasers, and swinging through lava like it’s just another Tuesday. And we’ve been... recharging. After launch, things got a little rough behind the scenes, and we needed a breather. Our publisher stepped away shortly after release, and honestly, we were a bit burnt out. But some rest, determination, and an unreasonable amount of space coffee later... we’re back with our biggest update yet.
— NEW SECRET CHALLENGES AWAIT —
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39373047/4107383f140f01d91a744acd24e3526a8f8f07a4.png"]

Almost every sector now hides brand-new secret challenge missions.
We’re talking fresh bosses, tough platforming, dangerous traps, and even more reasons to revisit every corner of the galaxy.

Find them all to unlock new achievements and prove you're the ultimate rebel operative.
It’s the most content we’ve added since launch, and we can’t wait to see who conquers them first.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39373047/11eddbccfea751643c2c664878b9d6f26943ff66.png"]
— WANT LORE WITH THAT LASER BLAST? —
We’ve reworked the tutorial to give you a better sense of the world, the rebellion, and what you’re really fighting for.
You can activate it anytime in the character select screen, great for new players, or for anyone wanting a little more story with their space carnage.
[hr][/hr]Patch Notes (aka what’s new in the galaxy)
New Content

Secret challenge missions added across almost every sector. Tons of new gameplay, enemies, and environments to master.

New achievements tied to completing secret challenges.

Updated tutorial with improved storytelling and lore delivery. Toggle it on in character select.

A note from the devs:
It’s been a while. After release, we hit a bit of a wall creatively. Between the stress of launch and some unexpected changes on the publishing side, we needed to take a step back. But we never stopped loving this game, or the players who kept playing it. Thank you for your patience and support. We’re excited to start updating DIG again.
[hr][/hr]
We’d love to hear what you think about the new content. Join us on Discord or wherever rebels gather. And if you’re enjoying the game, a review goes a long way, it really helps us keep going.

Now get out there. Dig deeper. Fight harder.
— The DIG team

notes.title: Dig & Swing Update
notes.content:
Salutations to you, weary space traveler! Your clothes look full of dirt and ash from digging earthy surfaces and venturing to volcanic planets with unlivable atmospheres, all in the name of the rebellion. We know exactly what you need, and it's our first content update bringing MORE of that!

It looks like some planets have orbited too close to their sector's suns and their surface has been completely scorched, tragically ending all life and lush greenery on them... which makes them perfect for some GRAPPLE HOOK PRACTICE!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39373047/d4c042bc64e38d921a389d85cd81130cf86bf20f.gif

Two new missions have been added to the game, in which you will have to prove your expertise with your rope and swing your way through fiery planets and reach the handsome rewards conveniently placed at their core. One false step (or swing) and you'll be toastier than Anakin Skywalker on the banks of Mustafar. Believe me, this is NOT the kind of tan you want to get.


There have also been reports from rebels across the galaxy, of an increasing number of underground caverns, imperial bases and secret stashes left by whoever came before us. From now, on you will be more likely to stumble upon a wider variety of underground structures as you dig through planets. 


In keeping with the rebel directive of 'Finders Keepers', any loot you find underground is rightfully yours. Just be careful, traps and enemies might be secretly waiting to ambush you in these small areas. Unfortunately for them, we've also added some improvements to your close range combat. You will now be able to learn a variety of skills that will affect different parameters of your melee weapons in ways that are almost excessive. Almost.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39373047/fd790d768ade4f07e5722fda961717c7728785e9.gif


See the full notes for the content update below with new improvements, features and adjustments:

Patch notes
QoL features
Added VSync feature to the options menu. Enable it if you experience screen tearing during gameplay.
Improvements and new features
 Two new missions that will require you to master the rope technique in order to achieve victory:
 "Floor is lava" in sector 2.
 "Cross the fire chasm" in sector 3.
 Added new skills centered around melee attacks. Melee builds will have nothing to envy ranged builds now.
 Increase your swing range
 Increased knock back to send every enemy to their home planets, where they are needed
 Hulk smash skill (internal name, pending legal issues). Basically, a big, slow, destructive blow.

 Added new secret underground structures to procedural maps. You didn't know about secret underground structures? Now you know.
 You will have now an increased chance of finding old and new secret areas while digging around, like caves full of swag and enemy lairs, to spice things up. 
 Increased the quality of rewards in all sectors to make them at least uncommon for sector 1, rare for sector 2, and mythic for sector 3 with a small chance of upgrading to superior rarity for each reward.
The "Evacuate the resistance base" mission (tree mission) have received an upgrade with different random sections inside the tree, making it now different every time you replay it.


Minor adjustments

 Debris thrower boss no longer can crash you to death after being defeated, ouch!
Updated sound effects for the Mace of tremors and Tremor cannon. Yes, your neighbors complained to us about the loud sounds.

How's that? We really want to know your opinions on the new content. People on our Twitter and Discord server got to see this before anyone else, so leave us a follow there and be the first to know about our next steps. And if you are enjoying the game, be sure to leave us a review letting us know about it, we really appreciate getting some love for our work.

Safe space travels!

notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
What's up space travellers and fellow Overlord opposers?

We're just briefly docking our spaceship to spread the news about our latest patch. We've gathered some of our loyal rebel's righteous feedback and jerry-rigged an update that will focus on accessibility. If you want to show us your support for the game, please leave a positive review. We'd much appreciate your heroic action!
Now, take a look at the improvements coming to the game.

New Quality of Life features in settings menu
Added an automatic dig/hit mode option - when enabled, keep the melee attack control pressed to dig/attack continuously, so you can wreck maximum chaos with minimum carpal tunnel.
Added an option to Disable screen shake. You may fight alien fauna, space pirates and galactic oppressors, but not dizziness.
Added an option to Disable bright flashes. We concluded it's a better fix than giving away sunglasses.
Added an option to Disable controller vibration. We get it, wrecking absolute havoc across the galaxy is an intense enough experience by itself.
Added a “Reset to default” button.
Bug fixes

 Fixed a bug that would put the game in fullscreen when window focus was lost then gained back, even without fullscreen activated in settings.
 Fixed a rare crash while browsing the Skills tab in the Japanese encyclopedia.

Other changes
Monk class is no longer unlocked by finishing the mission “Kill the crawlers”, which was never the intended behavior.

What's next in our course?
We are fully embarked in developing the first content update for DIG - Deep In Galaxies. There's still a bit to go, but we've already started testing some cool ideas we might or might not share from time to time on our Twitter and Discord channels, were other players of the game share their run and feedback.

As always, remember that your feedback is well received and will be put to good use. Most of these improvements come from user feedback, so we're always open to receiving any comment you might have about our game. Reviews are remarkably important to gain visibility, and help us a lot to keep improving. So, If you liked the game, please consider leaving a review letting us know about it!

DIG FORWARD!

notes.title: RELEASE BUILD PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
- We've reworked the backgrounds for the Grass, Barren, Snow and Ice biomes. Now you can enjoy better landscapes while you dig through their ecosystems.

- Fixed a bug preventing you from unlocking the Alien Sector. Apologies to all space travelers who ran out of fuel looking for it and are now drifting in space forever.

- Made adjustments to texts leading to the New Game+. Leonidas hints should be clearer now, or he will be fired.

- Your Space Encyclopedia has been updated with a new version, now including descriptions of the enemies you have defeated. Like a dating app except you've already swiped left.

- You will now get to meet more people after you get the True Ending *wink wink*.

- Action input (RB or E) is now dynamically displayed depending on the closest player’s
controller. YEAH, ok, we didn't think anything clever about this one.

- Made several adjustments to localization texts. Your Galactic Translators are operational now. Celebrate in your respective mother tongues.

- Several minor fixes and polishing to improve your game experience. The type you won't notice but makes your game experience way better. We hope!

notes.title: DIG - Deep In Galaxies is available NOW!
notes.content:
Welcome to the rebellion! Please stand in line to receive your grappling hook and double-jump license.

In DIG - Deep In Galaxies you will chart your own course as a space rebel, set to liberate the galaxy from a tyrannical Overlord. Only rule is, no rules. Will you go fully armed into battle against an army of rats, or face the Overlord's minions using a traffic sign as your weapon? Or will you choose to randomize your gear and make every battle an absurd and unpredictable challenge?

[previewyoutube=tZbjpCVUMJs;full][/previewyoutube]
No run will be the same! You might decide to excavate dangerous planets in search for relics left behind by ancient civilizations, or find yourself heroically carrying a potato sack to feed your fellow rebels. Or maybe you'll be gallivanting around the different sectors, looking for space stations to spend your well-earned ores and challenges to test your acrobatic, combat and digging skills.

Are you ready to take on everything the galaxy has to offer as a one man space-crew? Or will you gather your own group of misfits and free the universe with the power of weaponized friendship?

Journey into a galaxy of possibilities right now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1442840/DIG__Deep_In_Galaxies/

We would like to express our gratitude to all the early rebels who followed and supported us throughout early access. Your feedback has been so valuable in shaping DIG into what we're proud to share today. We hope you enjoy DIG - Deep In Galaxies' final release and come up with the craziest, most overpowered builds as a space revolutionary!

Please keep sharing your valuable feedback with us, so we can continue to improve the game by fixing any issues and expanding this galaxy of ours!

Tune in to our channels on your spaceship's radio, so you stay in the loop with every little update we make regarding DIG - Deep In Galaxies!

Discord - Twitter - TikTok

Time to kick some Overlord's butt!

notes.title: DIG - Deep In Galaxies final release set for 8th March!
notes.content:
Are you someone who loves exploring space and cherishes freedom? Do you feel deeply troubled by the existence of space dictatorships and have no preference for the kind of government that will replace them, as long as its leader doesn't self-identify as an Overperson? If this describes you, then the revolution has an opportunity that might interest you!

The revolution's exciting project DIG - Deep In Galaxies is officially launching March 8th. We have several open positions waiting for you, whether you're a bomber with a knack for explosions, a ninja from outer space or a doctor who prefers machetes over scalpels.

As part of the rebellion, your functions will be:
Working with a talented team of rebels who will do nothing to help you overthrow the tyrannical government. Imagine how much your resume will grow!
Explore the galaxy and chart your own course with no supervision whatsoever. Work independently and take ownership of your projects!
Bring a few friends in to assist you in your mission, with no boring selection processes needed! If you can fire, then you're hired. 
Benefits of working for the rebellion:

Choose how to face your challenges. Will you go full grenade-launcher or will you face your foes armed with a broken bottle? Your decision! 
Be the first to experiment combining skills no one has tested before! What will happen if you combine explosive ammunition with a perk to make all bullets ricochet? You will be the first to discover it.
You will be provided with your very own grappling-hook. Specially useful to play the rebellion's version of "the floor is lava" (in which the floor is, quite literally, lava).
Space challenges to spice up your adventure (low self-preservation instinct recommended).
Every day at work is different: the assignation of space sectors has been randomized you won't ever start your journey in the same place as the last time!
You get to work on your birthday! What gift would be better than dedicating your life to the liberation of the galaxy?
Salary range: Undisclosed (but you get to keep the ores you mine!)

And best of all, no previous experience or qualifications are needed! At all!

Don't miss your chance to leave a mark in space history and take your career to new heights (or depths, if you dig deep enough). We have no doubt that you will thrive in any position and make a valuable contribution to the future of the galaxy. 

Come aboard, and join the revolution!

notes.title: Update with fixes and adjustments
notes.content:
We are working on adding new content and features to DIG with every update. The Overlord's patch generator is a bit unstable yet, which means some wormholes may swallow your ongoing run. We are working on fixing this, but in the meantime, you can disable the automatic updates for this game on the Steam preferences.

Fixes in this update include:
- Added new backgrounds for the "Find the Holy Relic" mission.
- Fixed issue where treasure hunting space events didn't disappear correctly after visiting them.
- Updated super attack stat symbol in all skills icons.
- Fixed and issue where game sound played too loud on first launch.
- Fixed an issue where the game crashed after opening a money chest while holding 3 keys.
- Fixed an issue where wave counter box in arena didn't fit all languages.

notes.title: DIG - Deep In Galaxies is back on Early Access!
notes.content:
DIG - Deep In Galaxies is back on Early Access!

Remember that updating the game will erase any ongoing run! If you don't want to lose it, finish your run before updating the game.

Calling all space adventurers with a knack for butt-kicking!

After infiltrating the Overlord's base and managing to recover the stolen "Compile" button from his quarters, we finally have a version of the game that we consider complete, that meets our expectations and that we're really happy and proud to share.  We're still implementing some minor tweaks and adjustments, so we've decided to bring the game back into Early Access state.

So what does the Early Access mean?
As said, the Early Access means we're still making some small adjustments to the game, which don't keep it from being fully and truly enjoyable as it is. But what does it mean to you specifically, you might ask?

You can get the game at a discounted price. The game will have a higher price at final release, so this might be a perfect moment to save a few coins to spend at your favorite space cantina.
You get to share your incredibly valuable feedback with us, so we can take all your comments into consideration for the final launch. We can't stress enough how cool and interesting it is to get opinions and suggestions from our players, so don't be shy about it and SHARE your feedback. We'll love it!
Early Access also means the game has some issues you might encounter during your game. You can check the F.A.Q. pinned at discussions to see which issues are currently being worked on, and some workarounds for the most problematic of them.
Remember to report any anomalies you find during your odyssey through space to us on the forums, our social media, Discord or support email support@raisergames.com. Check these pages regularly to keep up to day with new updates.

Join the revolution!

notes.title: v0.9.5 "A New Name" Update is now available!
notes.content:
Hello there!

As you have seen, we have decided to change the name of the game. From now on it will no longer be The Mole Men, but it will be called DIG - Deep In Galaxies. This is important because now every time you search for the game in your Steam Library, you will need to use the new name DIG - Deep In Galaxies.

This change will also include a new look as part of our efforts to raise awareness of this game to other gaming communities.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39373047/e4d8126c24fd5bcc4b680287de60ec78c477b3e9.jpg

In addition to the new game style, a new update has been released (v0.9.5). In here, we have focused our efforts on further improving the overall gameplay experience of the game. We really hope that you like this new version and enjoy the new aspects that have changed since the last update. To recap, in this new version you will find:

 New encyclopedia where you will be able to consult all the unlockable content of the game and track your own progress
 New missions and events in the different sectors of the galaxy
 Redesign of Challenge Mode with optimization, balancing and new content
New feature in the Battle Mode to include a dynamic to win by round victories
 GUI enhancements for an even better gaming experience
 SFX (Sound Effects) adjustments
 And, of course, bug fixes to keep the game incredibly smooth!

For those of you who currently have an ongoing run from the previous version, this will be lost with the update. There’s too much new content that could not be transferred to previous runs, but all your overall game progress will remain intact.

Those who already own the game, or are very interested in testing it, can already join our Discord. There, you will be able to actively participate in the release process of the final version.

It is very important for us to receive your feedback after enjoying the game. That's why we invite you to join our community on Discord, write a Steam review or contact us through our email support@raisergames.com.

And if you want to support us, you can also follow us on Twitter and TikTok! There you will find lots of fun content :)

Stay tuned for the latest news and be part of this galactic journey!

notes.title: Coming soon: The Mole Men!
notes.content:
November 1st is getting closer by the day and we're now in the final sprint. For now we're releasing a big update. Let's talk about it!

Here's a small peak at what's coming your way on November 1st:

Skills based evolution - Each run will be a completely new experience thanks to the abundance of skills that will make you stronger, tougher, faster or even richer!
Meta-progression - Accomplishing high deeds will unlock new equipments, weapons and character classes for your future runs.
Competition - You'll be able to compete against other "The Mole Men" adepts to get the high score of the day with a single tentative.
Multiplayer - Multiply your chance of survival by playing with up to four people in cooperation to try to vanquish the terrible Overlord!
Challenge Mode - The Challenge Mode is not for the weak minded. Go through an endless series of challenges and battles of increasing difficulty.
Battle Mode - What better way to relax then to beat your friends to death in a free for all fight?

A huge thank you for everyone who already added The Mole Men to their wishlist and welcome to those of you who will! We can't wait to hear about your experience with our game!
